「おはようございます、志貴さん」
「おはよう琥珀さん。
悪いんだけど、ごはん作ってもらえるかな。
ずいぶんと眠ってておなかが減っちゃってさ」

いま支度をしますからしばらく待っていてくださいね」

“Of course. Give me a few minutes to prepare something.”
Kohaku hurried away toward the dining room.

秋葉も、おはよう」
「……………………」
　秋葉は不機嫌そうな顔で俺を一瞥するだけで、挨拶を返してこない。
「…………う」
　翡翠の教えてくれたとおり、昨夜のことを怒っているらしい。
　朝に『夜遊び厳禁！
』って注意されたのに、その日の深夜に外出すれば、そりゃあ秋葉だって怒って当然か。

lines.maoEnglish:
That left only Akiha and Hisui, who stood in silence like a statue.
“Hey, Akiha. Good morning.”
“……”
Akiha merely gave me a displeased glance, refusing to return the greeting.
“Urgh.”
Just as Hisui had warned me, she was angry about last night.
She had expressly forbidden late-night outings that morning, and then I had gone out after midnight the very same day. Of course she was angry.

“Don’t worry about it. That arm doesn’t hurt anymore.”
“How could it not hurt? You look ready to collapse, and there is blood on your left arm. Honestly, Brother—what have you been doing all this time?”
“……”
Unable to answer, I turn my eyes away from her.
I could never explain what happened tonight; more than that, I did not want to tell anyone what passed between Yumizuka and me.

「……別に。
街を歩いてたら酔っ払いにからまれただけだ。
ただのケンカ」
　簡潔に言って、秋葉の横を通りすぎる。
　そこを、ぐっ、と。
　秋葉に首根っこを掴まれてしまった。
「兄さん。
私、怒りますよ」
　どこか弱々しい声で、秋葉はまっすぐにこちらを見つめてくる。

lines.maoEnglish:
“Nothing. Some drunk picked a fight with me while I was walking through town. That’s all.”
I give her the barest answer and walk past.
Then—yank.
Akiha grabs me by the back of the collar.
“Brother. I am going to lose my temper.”
Her voice sounds strangely frail, and she looks straight into my eyes.
“……”
With a face like that, she only makes it harder for me to tell her the truth.
